rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when the speaker means producing or doing a lot, especially when the object is understood.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 se2 zo2 hou2 do1 go1

rows.note: Use this for explicitly large-scale production or output, especially in factual, professional, or written contexts.

example.english: This factory produces masks prolifically for the whole city.
example.traditional: 呢間工場大量生產口罩，供應全港。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 gung1 coeng4 daai6 loeng6 saang1 caan2 hau2 zaau3 gung1 jing3 cyun4 gong2
